name: Birmingham Vehicle Simulator
desc:
🇬🇧 Welcome to Birmingham Vehicle Simulator 🇬🇧

🏙️ Explore England’s second city with detailed busy city-centre roads.
🚕 Complete taxi jobs by transporting NPC passengers across the city.
🚍 Drive double-decker buses, follow schedules, & unlock new vehicles.
🚑 Respond to NPC emergencies as part of the emergency services.
🚓 Break the rules of the road — the police will respond dynamically.
🎨 Customise your vehicles with unique wraps & play alongside other players.
